cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a neighbourhood café with a counter and window seats — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; the nave of a Gothic cathedral with stained-glass windows — sitting on the ground; a present-day museum gallery of Three Kingdoms relics — standing; a vast fantasy library of towering shelves — standing; a sunny beach with wet sand and shallow surf — standing; the deck of a tall wooden sailing ship at sea — holds her keepsake at chest height; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — holds a gourd-shaped wine flask on a red cord by its cord at chest height; a pilot ready room beside a hangar — standing; a restored wooden plank road bolted to a sheer cliff in Sichuan — dries her hair with a towel; a steaming outdoor hot spring among rocks and bamboo — standing; a moonlit lotus pond with stepping stones and glowing fireflies — chest-deep in the water; a traditional archery ground beside a temple wall — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a neighbourhood grocery or convenience store with bright aisles — carries a paper shopping bag at her side
